Hi Sofia — thanks for the heads up and for sending the documents. A couple of quick items so we can process this cleanly:

1) We need the vendor-signed ACH authorization in our standard template (link below). The bank letter and W-9 are helpful, but our AP team requires the completed ACH form for Treasury to validate routing/account ownership.
2) For change control we briefly place affected POs on hold until verification completes. I’ve flagged PO #4321 — can you confirm whether that invoice has already been submitted? If so, please include the invoice number in your reply.
3) Please confirm the account name exactly as it appears on the new bank statement and whether Hartwell uses the same legal entity (Hartwell Logistics, Inc.) for remittance.

I’m looping in Grace from Finance to run validation once we receive the ACH form and bank confirmation. Grace — can you take the vendor verification once Sofia sends the signed ACH? If everything checks out we’ll lift holds and update the vendor record in the system.

ACH template: https://procure.redwood.com/forms/ACH_Template.pdf

Thanks — Karthik
